title: Same words. Other reading sequence.
intro: An edge note can be classified differently into the main text. Switch between two reconstructions and select a text part: its location on the demo page remains to be found.
comparison: The digital edition can reveal different reading sequences on the same material. The print chooses a well-founded sequence and explains alternatives in the apparatus.
git: Git records which text parts, assignments and model rules are underlying a view. The historical order is an editorial hypothesis; it is not read from the sequence of modern commits.

hypotheses.title: Reconstruction A
hypotheses.explanation: First Clara at the gate, then the darkening city: The marginal note is classified after Clara's arrival.

hypotheses.title: Reconstruction B
hypotheses.explanation: First the darker city, then Clara at the gate: The same marginal note opens the passage. The connection is weighted differently.
